questions.stem: Rubidium is below potassium in Group 1. How would its reaction with water compare to potassium?

options.text: Less vigorous, because rubidium is larger
More vigorous, because reactivity increases down Group 1

questions.explanation: Rubidium is below potassium in Group 1, and reactivity increases going down the group. Rubidium's outer electron is further from the nucleus with more shielding, so it is lost even more easily. The reaction would be very violent, likely explosive.
